comments.text:
I'm building a so called tiny home 43 ft by 10 wide.  I'm a good 80 grand in.  And that's just for material, I'm doing all the work for free.  And I'm 90 percent done.  So I don't see how people can sell theirs for this price, without cutting some serious corners.  I know I added many things that you will never see in other tiny's.  My buddies tore down a old cedar barn & gifted me all the wood.  And I'm gonna use it for some accent walls.  It's gonna take a ton of time to cut all that wood & sand it down.  But I want it to look sharp.  I was gonna sell it.  Now I'm getting close to finishing it.  I know it's gonna be so nice,  now I want to keep it.  
Bottom line is you get what you pay for.  You buy something cheap, your gonna get something cheap.  Mine is basically a one bedroom apartment.  Full size everything.  On demand water heater, washer/dryer with tons & tons of storage. 4 closets.  In the main bedroom I lowered the loft so you can stand up & walk around your bed.  With full size his & her closets.  No ladders,  I didn't want to be crawling around like a little kid.  SO full size stairs.  I agree with a lot in this video & disagree with a lot.  Yes most tiny don't have any storage.  But if I'm making this, I can put as much as I want in it.  Besides it being on a steel trailer it's framed like a real house.  No half ass stuff.  The ceiling has proper ventilation (baffles).  What I'm trying to say is yes many tinys are built cheap as possible & are not up to code.  And most people will never know any better.  And I get that most people don't have time/knowledge to go out & build a house.  It will cost more then you thought & take a hell of a lot longer then you thought to build.
